title: Guess the Number Using Bitwise Questions II
summary: Recover the original hidden 30-bit integer n. Calling commonBits(num) first counts equal bit positions in n and num across all 30 bits, then mutates n to n XOR num, then returns the count. Queries must also be 30-bit nonnegative integers. Return the initial value, not the final mutated value.
